ClientPrints.title: Order a print
ClientPrints.intro: Choose a print of this photo. You don't pay now; the photographer will contact you.
ClientPrints.name: Your name
ClientPrints.phoneHint: The photographer uses it to arrange payment and delivery.
ClientPrints.paymentNote: Placing the order doesn't charge you. The photographer confirms the price, payment and delivery with you.
ClientPrints.failed: Your order didn't go through. Check your connection and try again.
ClientPrints.rateLimited: You've placed several orders in a short time. Please try again in an hour or message the photographer.
ClientPrints.unavailable: This print is no longer available. Choose another one or message the photographer.
ClientPrints.sessionEnded: Your gallery session ended. Reload the page and enter the password again.
ClientPrints.doneBody: {photographer} will contact you about payment and delivery.
ClientPrints.whatsappText: Hi, I just ordered a print (order #{number}).
